items.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: That's Welch, I know that, huh? That's guitar there.

ctx.x: Okay. I think you own this one.

That's Welch, I know that, huh? That's guitar there. Song And what is this call, this room here? This is a little station, south where we play our electric unit where we send it up to a different dormitory. This is a radio station? Yes sir. We have a hookup unit and a mic in each dormitory, going to dormitory 1 and dormitory 2. Oh yeah, I see. And a mic in the yard too, the fellas in the yard, and both can hear the music in three ways. And what's today's day? Let me get that down here. Today is January 12th,…
